items.title: Ferguson Enterprises (FERG) Stock Looks Fairly Valued On Cash Flow
items.summary: Ferguson Enterprises has logged a strong share price run in recent years, which naturally pushes investors to ask whether the current US$248.53 level is properly supported by the cash the business can generate. With the spotlight on its cash flows rather than just the chart, the question now is how well that price lines up with an intrinsic value estimate built from those streams of money.
